result.answer_string: {"answer": "Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. The model estimates parameters (weights) that maximize the likelihood of observing the training data. Once trained, logistic regression can predict class probabilities and assign class labels based on a chosen threshold (commonly 0.5).
